items.title: What do employers usually look for in hiring?

values: Premise｜B1—B5 are entirely fictional, with no real tickets or passenger data
In 30 minutes, complete a one-page cost table, a connection check, and a status and to-check handover card; use only the premise and do not contact carriers, pay, or issue tickets.
B1｜order requirements: 2 adults, all times on the same day and in the same time zone; no names, credentials, or real schedules were provided.

B2｜fictional one-way base price 320 yuan/person, taxes and fees 40 yuan/person; optional baggage 60 yuan/person. In this exercise both people explicitly select baggage, and the total without it is listed separately.
B3｜arrival 10:00, next departure 10:45; this exercise assumes a minimum connection of 50 minutes, and this number is not an actual carrier standard.
B4｜no actual inventory, payment, confirmation, or issuance receipt was provided, and the price validity period is unknown; the premise quote must not be written as a successful booking.
B5｜no refund or change, specific baggage, or special service policy was provided; do not estimate refunds, promise free rebooking, or guarantee that travel will succeed.
Task and outputs
Break down base price, taxes and fees, party size, and baggage selections, check the time difference and premise conditions, and write the real evidence gaps clearly.
Submit one page with the cost formula, the connection judgment, the unconfirmed and unticketed status, and at least three to-check questions.
Reference answer (complete it independently first)
Base total 2×(320+40)=720 yuan; with both people selecting baggage, add 2×60=120 yuan for a total of 840 yuan. Add-ons have selection conditions and must not be charged by default.
10:45−10:00=45 minutes; 50−45=5 minutes, which does not satisfy the premise minimum connection. The real segment's dates, time zones, stations, and standards must be checked separately.

Status: to check, unconfirmed, unticketed; without payment evidence it is not marked as paid either. Ask about actual availability, price validity, refund and change, and baggage conditions, and obtain evidence under authorization before processing.
Boundaries and handover
This is only a paper check, not a real quote or transportation advice. When policy is missing, list questions; do not fabricate inventory, payment, ticket numbers, or refunds to finish the table.

title.text: Transportation ticket and travel clerks: booking, fare checking, and entry paths

subject.name: Transportation Ticket and Travel Clerks
subject.summary: Transportation ticket and travel clerks look up and confirm transportation or accommodation reservations, explain schedules and costs, and handle invoices, payments, and ticket records. Some positions at airports and stations also check baggage, issue boarding passes, and assist passengers; this is not the same as travel agents or flight attendants.
